title: Bash 5+ / POSIX Shell Scripting
summary: Bash 5+ / POSIX, shellcheck, shfmt, bats-core, modular bin/ + lib/
rules: Strict mode mandatory: #!/usr/bin/env bash followed by set -euo pipefail and IFS=$'\n\t'.
Quoting safety: ALWAYS double-quote variable expansions ("$var", "${array[@]}").
Cleanup traps: Use trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM for temporary files or process cleanup.
Negative Constraints: NEVER use eval, NEVER use legacy backticks (use $(...)).
